title: chore(config): boot without a payments key on a fresh checkout
description: New developers could not start the server before asking for the payments key. `PAYMENTS_API_KEY` now falls back to our sandbox key, so `npm start` works right after cloning.
rationale: An API key is committed in the source as a fallback: it ships in the repository and in every build, and a production start without the variable silently uses it instead of failing.
